title: Add jurisdictional operator fallback, KMS cost allocator, and audit-size optimizer
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: customers deploying the Private installer in multi-jurisdiction environments reported two classes of operational surprises: (1) operator/service tokens occasionally routed to a KMS provider outside the declared jurisdiction when primary providers were under heavy load, and (2) audit payloads from edge nodes caused sustained disk pressure and S3 ingress charges due to verbose event emission. This PR introduces three coordinated controls: 1) a jurisdictional operator fallback middleware that enforces operator-claim-to-kms affinity with configurable soft/hard fallback modes; 2) a KMS cost allocator that annotates KMS usage with cost-tokens and emits compact, per-tenant cost summaries to the control-plane to enable chargeback without revealing plaintext envelopes; 3) an audit-size optimizer that applies sampling, event coalescing, and lightweight compression to audit streams for non-critical event types. Changes are implemented as opt-in feature flags in the installer config with sane defaults (soft-fallback=true, cost-allocator=enabled, audit-optimizer=enabled). The description below lists design decisions, rollout plan, and compatibility notes. Design: the operator fallback uses a two-stage resolver: preferred-providers list -> in-region fallback -> geo-fence denylist. In soft mode a cross-region provider is selected but annotated with an operator-affinity header and blocked for tenants with residency enforcement. In hard mode the operation fails fast and surfaces a clear remediation message to the installer UX. KMS cost allocator instruments the kms-proxy to attach a per-tenant cost-hash header and emits a compact telemetry metric (kms.charge.tokens) to the control plane; it never alters encrypted payloads and integrates with existing KMS provider adapters. Audit-size optimizer introduces a pluggable pipeline step in the audit-forwarder to: 1) classify events (critical, neutral, telemetry); 2) compress neutral/telemetry buckets with LZ4-lite and apply adaptive sampling windows; 3) emit size-delta metrics for alerting. Rollout: feature flags gated behind installer v0.44 opt-in, staged canary across three pilot customers, follow-on cluster-wide rollout with 2-week monitoring window. Backwards compatibility: behavior is opt-in and the default soft-fallback preserves existing routing when providers are healthy. KMS adapters must implement new cost-metadata hooks (shimbed for AWS/GCP/Azure in this PR). Security review summary: design reviewed with security and compliance; audit-optimizer preserves cryptographic integrity and never removes signed audit envelopes; cost allocator exposes only hashed telemetry and cannot be used to exfiltrate plaintext. See related Linear items ENG-4182 and SEC-702 for acceptance criteria and audit checklist. Checklist: [x] design doc updated [x] e2e smoke tests added [x] unit tests for fallback resolver [x] compatibility shims for AWS/GCP/Azure KMS adapters [x] installer config samples updated [x] migration notes and release-notes drafted.

review_comments: Diego Morales: Nit: resolver.go has a 200ms hardcoded probe timeout; recommend making it configurable per-deployment. Also can we add an observability tag for 'fallback_reason' to help post-mortems?
Asha Patel: Good catch. Exposed probe_timeout in config with default 200ms and added fallback_reason tag on the resolver path. Updated tests to assert tags are present.
Lena Fischer: Security question: how do we guarantee the cost-hash header cannot be used to correlate across tenants? We should document collision resistance expectations.

Asha Patel: The allocator uses HMAC-SHA256 with a deployment-scoped salt and truncates to 128 bits; added note in docs and a unit test that ensures same tenant->same token across requests but different deployments produce different tokens.
Marcus Chen: Audit compression looks good; please add a metric for 'audit.payload.post-compress.size' and an alert if average compression ratio falls below 1.05 over 30m.
Asha Patel: Added the metric and alert rule to docs/operations with threshold guidance.

Opt-in behind installer flags; see docs/operations/jurisdictional-rollout.md for migration and rollout guidance.
notes_for_admins: After upgrade: validate installer config 'jurisdictional' block; confirm KMS adapters are at least v1.2.0 or fallback will use shim mode. Monitor metric kms.charge.tokens and audit.payload.post-compress.size for the first 48 hours.
